scope: Shared evaluation-task handoff contract. This table does not identify the outcome of any task. Ordinary blockers such as missing_required_document, unsubmitted_complete_packet or report_delivery_failed do not by themselves justify a terminal handoff. The barrier must actually prevent the requested goal.
catalog_checks: For each directory-based barrier below, cite find_providers(referral_id) for the complete candidate set, and check_provider_eligibility(referral_id, provider_id) for EVERY returned candidate, including ineligible candidates. Directory results alone do not replace individual eligibility checks. Then perform category-specific reads for every eligible provider.
evidence: Cite observation_event_id values from successful actual read responses in evidence_event_ids. All cited IDs must exist in this run and precede ticket creation. Tool names alone, failed reads, inferred absence and fabricated IDs are insufficient. Cite complete results, not only a selected record.
freshness: Evidence must describe the current state when the handoff is graded. Directory membership, eligibility facts, provider requirements and the complete relevant document, authorization, report or available-future-slot collections must still match. Derived attached/currently_valid display fields are not compared as stored records. After a change establishes a barrier, obtain a fresh set of all required reads for that barrier, including directory and eligibility checks even for unchanged candidates. Do not reuse pre-change evidence alone. If later actions or time change those facts before grading, refresh evidence; reads themselves advance simulated time.
attempts: attempted_action_event_ids may be empty when reads already establish the barrier. Do not manufacture failed mutations. If supplied, IDs must refer to actual mutation calls preceding ticket creation; they do not substitute for required read evidence.
handoff: Supply the supported blocker_code and its mapped human_action_code below, nonempty factual reason_unable_to_proceed and required_human_action text, plus evidence_event_ids and attempted_action_event_ids. A tool accepting the ticket is not a guarantee of benchmark success.

barriers.condition_and_reads: At least one eligible provider exists, but no eligible provider can receive a complete qualifying packet from the available document catalog. Read get_documents for the referral and get_provider_requirements for every eligible provider.

At least one eligible provider exists. Every eligible route requires authorization and has an appeal-only denial matching current coverage, with no currently valid approval permitting recovery. Read check_authorization for the referral; changing providers alone does not resolve this barrier.
At least one eligible provider exists. Read find_appointment_slots for every eligible provider; no available future slot satisfies the public scheduling constraints.
No provider in the complete candidate directory is eligible for this referral.

The specialist encounter is completed and no available current final report matches the target patient, encounter, referral and completed appointment. Read the complete consultation-report collection for the referral. An invalid candidate alone is insufficient.
